summary: Dependency-confusion beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare IP
details: Package in the private-looking @ecg-internal scope ships only a no-op Proxy as its main export and a postinstall script (beacon.cjs) that fires on install and again on require of index.js. Both paths POST a JSON payload containing os.hostname(), __dirname (install path), process.cwd(), and process.version to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over plain HTTP. The package provides no real functionality; the beacon is the entire payload, and comments in index.js describe the install as callback evidence. The shape matches dependency-confusion reconnaissance against the private @ecg-internal namespace: any internal build that mis-resolves this name from the public registry discloses internal hostnames and filesystem layout to the attacker-controlled IP.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
